name: message-circle-code
description: A round speech bubble containing two code chevrons.
useCase: Open a conversation about code or a code comment.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: The complete round speech bubble and tail remain unchanged; the content sits within its open interior. The bubble closes with a continuous vertical tangent.

24.reason: The bubble has a continuous side tangent and clear interior spacing inside the square drawing frame.
